name: agy-supervised-development
description: Astra plans and reviews code; AGY implements and executes Astra-defined tests through Herdr.

interface.longDescription: Use Astra for problem framing, code-only review and test design; use Herdr-managed AGY for implementation, bounded rework and execution of frozen test metrics.
capabilities: Implement and rework through Herdr-managed AGY
Freeze measurable test plans and metrics
Complete from AGY test evidence without a second test review
interface.defaultPrompt: Use AGY Supervised Development 4.1: Astra frames the problem and Contract, AGY implements without formal testing, Astra reviews code until PASS, Astra freezes the test plan and metrics, then AGY executes the tests; if test-stage code changes, return to Astra code review before completion.
